meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Teams 适配器及其注册测试复制进 src/channels/、加上注册 import、安装 @chat-adapter/teams@4.29.0,再跑构建和注册测试;随后引导你用 Teams CLI 登录 Microsoft 365、创建机器人并把凭据写进 .env。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加上 Microsoft Teams 频道支持时接管;前提是有一个能创建 Entra 应用并上传自定义应用的 Microsoft 365 账号(免费个人版 Teams 不行),以及一条指向本机 3000 端口的 HTTPS 隧道。

say.text: 帮我加上 Microsoft Teams 频道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: .env 里已经有 Teams 凭据了,直接跳到重启那步
say.note: 检测到凭据就跳过创建流程

say.text: 我想把助手接到另一个 Teams 用户上
say.note: 按 Entra 对象 ID 指定接线目标

howto.what_en: It copies the Teams adapter and its test into src/channels/, adds the registration import, installs @chat-adapter/teams@4.29.0, builds, then guides Teams CLI sign-in and bot creation and writes credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Use when adding Microsoft Teams channel support to NanoClaw; it needs a Microsoft 365 tenant (free personal Teams won't qualify) and an HTTPS tunnel to port 3000.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams channel support for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Teams credentials already exist in .env — skip to restart
say_en.note: Existing creds skip the create flow

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to a different Teams user
say_en.note: Target set by Entra object ID
